limitations.title: CRITICAL: pg.Pool.query() hangs forever
limitations.evidence: createPool() replaces pool.connect with an async function that ignores the callback. node-postgres Pool.query() calls connect(callback). The callback is never invoked, so schema helpers, health(), and check() deadlock. Each hung call also leaks a pool slot.
limitations.impact: db.schema.*, db.health(), db.check(), and any code using db.pool.query hang until the client is killed

limitations.title: db.health() and db.check() deadlock
limitations.evidence: createCheck() uses pool.query('SELECT 1')
limitations.impact: Readiness/liveness probes cannot use the built-in health API

limitations.title: All db.schema.* DDL helpers deadlock
limitations.evidence: schema/create.ts, alter.ts, drop.ts, constrain.ts, introspect.ts call pool.query() directly
limitations.impact: Schema helpers are unusable; callers must use db.query() for DDL

limitations.title: Query retry is opt-in (disabled by default)
limitations.evidence: Serialization failures (40001) and deadlocks (40P01) are not retried unless retry options are passed
limitations.impact: Transient errors fail the request unless the application configures retry

limitations.title: health() cannot report down for a dead port because it uses hanging pool.query()
limitations.evidence: createCheck never returns {status:'down'} if connect callback is dropped
limitations.impact: Readiness probes can deadlock the process

limitations.title: Optimistic locking on updateById threw
limitations.evidence: Optimistic locking requires "version" in the WHERE clause
limitations.impact: Callers must pass the version column in data/where

limitations.title: queryAllShards total != inserted rows
limitations.evidence: {"results":[{}],"successfulShards":["shard-0","shard-2","shard-1"],"failedShards":[],"partial":false}
limitations.impact: Fan-out is not a global snapshot

limitations.title: Sharded db.transaction() without shardKey uses the default shard
limitations.evidence: Did not throw
limitations.impact: Easy to write to the wrong shard

limitations.title: Missing defaultShardId falls back to the first shard with only console.warn
limitations.evidence: createDatabase did not throw
limitations.impact: Un-keyed writes land on shard-0

limitations.title: Replication replica here is an independent primary, not a streaming standby
limitations.evidence: Five clusters were started with wal_level=replica but no pg_basebackup/hot_standby follower
limitations.impact: replica-preferred can read unrelated data; lag via pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() needs a real standby (PG 13+)

limitations.title: Schema auto-sync is off unless schemaSync + coordination DB are configured
limitations.evidence: db.schemaSync was undefined
limitations.impact: Multi-shard DDL drift is not repaired automatically

limitations.title: Failover does not elect a new primary by itself
limitations.evidence: FailoverManager + HaProvider integrate Patroni / pg_auto_failover / custom providers
limitations.impact: Without external HA, a dead primary stays dead

limitations.title: PostgreSQL only — no MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server adapters
limitations.evidence: package.json depends solely on pg; engines node>=20
limitations.impact: Cannot target anything except PostgreSQL

limitations.title: This run used PostgreSQL 15.19, not the upstream testcontainers image postgres:16
limitations.evidence: Debian postgresql-15 because Docker was unavailable
limitations.impact: PG 16-only catalog changes untested; replication lag helper needs PG 13+

limitations.title: No Docker / Testcontainers in this environment
limitations.evidence: Five local clusters under /var/lib/postgresql/real-test ports 5432,5440-5443
limitations.impact: Upstream vitest globalSetup cannot run without Docker

limitations.title: Physical streaming replication was not configured
limitations.evidence: All five instances are independent primaries
limitations.impact: Lag-aware replica routing, WAL LSN waits, and failover promotion were not fully exercised

limitations.title: Hardcoded timeouts remain in source
limitations.evidence: CONNECTION_LEAK_TIMEOUT=300000 in client.ts; cursor 5m/30s in cursor.ts; pool leak timer not unref'd
limitations.impact: Cannot tune leak/cursor timeouts; timers keep Node from exiting

limitations.title: No global connection budget across shards
limitations.evidence: Each shard Pool has its own max
limitations.impact: N shards * max can exceed PostgreSQL max_connections

limitations.title: Coordination database is a SPOF for 2PC metadata
limitations.evidence: DistributedTransactionCoordinator persists to a single coordinationPool
limitations.impact: If coordination DB dies, in-flight 2PC cannot record decisions

limitations.title: Module-level Sets retain PoolClients (activeConnections, manualClients)
limitations.evidence: src/client/pool.ts and src/client/client.ts never clear on shutdown
limitations.impact: Long-running apps can leak memory across createDatabase() generations
